Dear Madam
I have put it in [Mrs Matthew](/person/1689)’s hands, whether to put in the article, or an apology.
The number of [Mothers in Council](/periodical/82) being all arranged, it is very inconvenient, as some contributor must be put off

yours truly

C M Yonge
